title: Design System: Vanguard AV web app

body.purpose: Explanations, result text, and input values.

components.name: Start scan
components.css: .ds-button { background: #1c7304; color: #ffffff; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #237f08; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { background: #175e05; } .ds-button:disabled { background: #161a16; color: #a1afa0; cursor: default; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8cdb78; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: View details
components.css: .ds-button { background: #111411; color: #e2ebe0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; border-radius: 12px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid #708070; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #202820; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { background: #203521; } .ds-button:disabled { background: #161a16; color: #a1afa0; cursor: default; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8cdb78; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Show the label, field, and help together.
components.html: Enter the address you want to check.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: #e2ebe0; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { box-sizing: border-box; background: #08080a; color: #e2ebe0; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 12px; font: 400 1rem/1.5rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid #708070; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #a1afa0; opacity: 1; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #8cdb78; } .ds-field[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #ff9d9d; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8cdb78; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-help { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: #a1afa0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Review badge
components.description: A visible label for the review verdict.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; background: #382b14; color: #f2c66b; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Finding panel
components.description: Present the finding, its explanation, and the next step in that order.
components.html:
Coverage is incomplete

One check could not be completed.

Review the available checks before deciding what to do.
components.css: .ds-finding { background: #111411; color: #e2ebe0; border: 1px solid #243024; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem; } .ds-heading { margin: 0; font: 600 1.125rem/1.5rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-description, .ds-next { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; color: #a1afa0; font: 400 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-finding { padding: 1.5rem; } }

components.name: Current navigation item
components.description: Mark the current page with a shape cue and a distinct surface.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { background: #203521; color: #8cdb78; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; align-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; border-inline-start: 3px solid #8cdb78; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8cdb78; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The workspace inherits the Vanguard helmet and wordmark, green-black surfaces, and Outfit typography. It uses quiet panels and a clear reading order so people can find the scan action, understand a verdict, and see what to do next.
keyCharacteristics: Vanguard green actions and brighter brand highlights on green-black surfaces
Solid surfaces and visible control boundaries
Outfit for the UI and JetBrains Mono for evidence
Distinct labels for verdict, coverage, and progress

rules.name: The action and verdict rule
rules.body: The primary green fill identifies the main action. A scan outcome has its own text and tone, even when the outcome is favorable.

dos: Do use the shared palette, radius, and spacing roles before adding a new token. If implementation proves a new role is needed, update the app tokens, this document, and the preview together.
Do pair scan outcomes with a visible label, scope of coverage, and a next step when appropriate.

Do check default, hover, focus, pressed, disabled, loading, empty, error, and partial-result states for any component that supports them. Check keyboard, touch, zoom, and reduced motion on the first real workflow.
donts: Don't use the public site's decorative headlines, glossy effects, or moving card tracks in the workspace's routine controls and result views.
Don't use color alone for selection, errors, or verdicts, or show a favorable verdict merely because processing completed.
